title: SANA-Video 2.0 hybrid attention at reduced scale
description: At 190M-parameter scale on UCF-101, the 25%-softmax hybrid recovers 86-94% of full softmax attention's quality gap over pure-linear attention (held-out loss and I3D FVD, seed-robust) while its speedup over softmax grows to 1.94x at 65k tokens; AttnRes routing reuse and matched-step rank gains reproduce qualitatively, with smaller ablation magnitudes than reported.
